title: US AI Task Force to Report on Technology’s Risks, WSJ Reports
description: A new White House task force will produce a report assessing risks posed by artificial intelligence and what responsibility the US federal government should have over the technology, the Wall Street Journal reported.

title: Bessent Says AI Industry Must Own Its Risks and Find Solutions
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent criticized prominent artificial-intelligence figures’ warnings about existential risks posed by the technology as alarmist and unhelpful, calling on the industry to police itself and produce solutions.

title: US Hackers Face $1,000 Monthly Pay Cut in Controversial Plan
description: US soldiers tasked with hacking American adversaries and defending the nation’s computers are set to see their incentive pay cut by as much as $12,000 a year as part of an overhaul that’s drawn ire from the ranks, according to documents reviewed by Bloomberg and people familiar with the situation.
